title: The Brave Little Rabbit
text: Once there was a little rabbit named Pip. Pip was small but very brave. One day, Pip saw a big storm coming. All the other animals were scared. But Pip hopped to the hill and showed everyone a safe cave to hide in. The animals were safe because Pip was brave and kind. Everyone cheered for Pip!
moral: Being brave means helping others, even when you are small.
discussionQuestion: When have you been brave like Pip?

title: The Curious Star
text: Tara was a little star who wanted to see the Earth up close. Every night, she watched children playing below. One night, Tara twinkled very brightly to say hello. A little girl saw her and waved. Tara felt happy. She learned that even small stars can bring big smiles.
moral: You can make someone happy with a small, kind gesture.
discussionQuestion: How can you make someone smile today?

title: StudIQ and the Lost Button
text: StudIQ found a shiny blue button on the path. 'Someone must be looking for this,' StudIQ said. StudIQ asked the fox, the owl, and the bear. None of them had lost a button. Then StudIQ met a sad turtle. 'I lost my favorite button!' the turtle said. StudIQ gave it back. The turtle smiled a big turtle smile.
moral: Honesty means giving things back to their owner.
discussionQuestion: What would you do if you found something that wasn't yours?
